name: Runemaster Granite Shield is granted every 20 sec only while Runic Tattoos: Earth is active (#883)
contract: Granite Shield 806996 reads 'While Runic Tattoos: Earth is active, you now periodically gain Granite Shield
every $t1 sec.' Its only effect is native SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, amplitude 20000 ms, triggering
Granite Shield 520822 (SCHOOL_ABSORB, 20 s, 'Absorbs ${$m1+$ppl1+$AP*.1+$SP*.3} damage'), with no caster aura
requirement, so the shield came every 20 s with or without the tattoo. Expected: no shield while no Earth
tattoo is active; with the caster's own Runic Tattoos: Earth 801094 (spell_ranks chain 801094, 803754-803758) a
shield absorbing at least $m1 (300) arrives at the next 20 s tick; after switching to Runic Tattoos: Fire 801106
the shield expires and is not renewed.

steps.label: Pass the first 20 s tick without a tattoo
CONTRACT: no Granite Shield without Runic Tattoos: Earth
CONTRACT: the next tick grants Granite Shield
The shield absorbs at least its base 300
Let the shield expire through the next tick
CONTRACT: the shield is not renewed without Runic Tattoos: Earth
